description:
Considered a boost-type panel.
When used by an enemy, boosts magical damage received by 50% for 1 attack.
When used by an ally, boosts own skill power by 40% for 1 turn and
boosts all allies' M.ATK by 5%. (MAX 50%)
name: Wisdom Release Panel
